fusions.name: Wriggling Clod
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod of wet silt that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Sluice Cut
fusions.desc: Cuts a sluice that floods a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 14 damage to everything in it, throws each enemy back 3 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Mire
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Silt Scales
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of dried silt scales: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.
